name: Crack
body:
School transmutation; Level bard 0, cleric/oracle 0, druid 0, sorcerer/wizard 0

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range touch
Target one object of up to 10 cu. ft., one undead, or construct creature
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw Will negates (object); Spell Resistance yes (object); see text

DESCRIPTION

This spell deals 1d3 points of damage to an object, construct, or undead creature, ignoring hardness and damage reduction.
